purpose: close the last known methodological gap from arena-mem0-breadth-ablation-v1: mechanism_ablation.py had the same continue-vs-break truncation bug as mem0_breadth_arms.py, and is what produced the reused Hindsight context-size curve (4/10, 6/10, 6/10) this experiment compared Mem0 against.
source_of_truth_for_hindsight_context: data/lab/arena/raw/arena-expansion-v1/hindsight.json, verified unchanged since the original ablation run (mtime and content predate today's Mem0 work; the audit's own reconstruction matched the historically recorded context_items/context_tokens/gold_state exactly once the mem0-matched budget was pinned -- see below)

what_was_fixed.truncate_continue_to_break: same defect and same fix as mem0_breadth_arms.py: STOP at the first item that overflows the budget instead of skipping it to pack a smaller later one in.
what_was_fixed.kept_times_alignment: kept_times was computed as `[times[i] for i,item in enumerate(items) if item in keep][:len(keep)]` -- matching evidence times to kept items by TEXT, not position. Provably coincides with the correct `times[:len(keep)]` whenever keep is a true prefix (which it always is now), but that safety depended entirely on truncate() never skipping. Replaced with direct positional slicing; simpler and unconditionally correct.
what_was_fixed.regression_tests: tests/test_mechanism_ablation.py: 5 tests -- stop-not-skip, duplicate-text items considered independently by position, prefix invariant, an end-to-end build_arms() case with a duplicated item text that would trip a text-matching alignment, and gold_rank counting only retained evidence.
what_was_fixed.ledger_run_id_bug_found_while_reusing_ru: both scripts hardcoded their own ledger run_id, so passing --cap-scope ablation-fix- for this correction did not actually scope anything (the ledger lines still carried run_id=clean-breadth-reader/clean-breadth-judge from the Mem0 breadth work, which happens to satisfy neither prefix meaningfully once reused across experiments). The $0.10 cap for this correction was therefore enforced only by the flat --cap-usd per-run ceilings (0.05+0.05), not by scope tracking. No overspend resulted (true combined cost was $0.0080), but the scope mechanism itself did not gate it as intended. Fixed by adding --run-id to both scripts, defaulting to their prior hardcoded values so existing behavior is unchanged.

mem0_matched_budget_provenance: raw/arena-expansion-v1/mem0.json is NOT a stable artifact -- it is silently overwritten by the newest Mem0 run against the same selection_id, which is exactly what happened this session (the clean rerun overwrote it around 06:58 UTC). Recomputing the hindsight_mem0_matched budget from it today would silently swap in the CLEAN Mem0 context sizes instead of the CONTAMINATED ones the original ablation actually matched against. Pinned instead to the budget_tokens value recorded per-unit in the original raw/mechanism-ablation/outputs.json, so only the truncation rule changed -- nothing else about what is being measured did.
audit_method: current (pre-fix) build_arms() was imported and re-run against the still-frozen raw/arena-expansion-v1/hindsight.json to reconstruct exactly what context each of the 30 (arm,unit) pairs used; reconstruction cross-validated at 30/30 against the historically recorded context_items/context_tokens/gold_state once the matched budget was pinned. The fixed build_arms() was then run to produce the corrected 30 arms. No provider call in either step.

diff_result.gold_state_changed: 0 of 30 -- the bug changed which filler evidence surrounded the truncation boundary, not whether gold was retained, on this data
diff_result.judged_label_changed_by_the_fix: 1 of 30 (gpt4_f420262c, hindsight_mem0_matched, False->True; gold was already in context both before and after)

reused_without_new_payment.hindsight_full_3117_score: 7/10, from fixed-reader-judged-all.json, untouched: no truncation is ever applied to this arm so the bug cannot affect it
reused_without_new_payment.hindsight_retrieval_and_ingest: entirely reused, per instruction; no new Hindsight call of any kind this correction

spend.note: true total taken from the raw output files' own recorded cost_usd, not from ledger run_id buckets, because of the run_id-scoping gap described above. Both figures independently corroborate: 0.0048+0.0032=0.0080 matches the ledger's raw delta over this correction's wall-clock window.
